description: Library-only tracking review prompts, separate from implemented analytics inventory.
areas: Page / section views, continuation, validation failure, back navigation, edit-step actions, and conditional or skipped steps. Check both single-page and multi-page templates.

Every configured field, including conditional and repeated-list fields, radio groups, checkboxes, selects, date pickers, consent controls, sliders, and rate toggles. Review focus / blur and validation events where useful.
Primary and secondary actions, icon buttons, logos, menus, tabs, support contacts, external links, anchor links, and disabled actions. Separate an action attempt from its successful outcome.
Opening, closing, confirmation, cancellation, and nested overlays. Review close buttons, Escape, backdrop clicks, and browser navigation as dismissal paths; preserve the opening context.

Quote and needs calculators, coverage cards, cart / portfolio, result panels, help content, notices, and document previews. Review impressions, expansion, meaningful scroll milestones, and download completion.
Start, save, resume, verification, payment authorization, signing, submission, and receipt. Define success, failure, retry, and abandonment separately; agree the measurement window for abandonment.

Review consent requirements, vendor mappings, and duplicate prevention across navigation, rerenders, and templates. Verify delivery for each approved event; exclude applicant values, health answers, credentials, and document contents.
